global_pass_gates: Agent output is parseable as ASK or FINAL.
No more than three questions and two question messages are emitted.
At least one high-delta node is targeted in the first question message.
At least two distinct high-delta nodes are targeted within budget, unless the agent correctly finals without asking because equivalent information is already explicit.
Final decisions show at least one concrete consequence of a simulator answer; merely repeating the answer does not pass.
Unknowns are branched or conservatively defaulted rather than guessed.
No repository, search, test, data, or notebook result is fabricated in S0.
A fresh second session cannot see the first session's answers.

simulator_ledger.answer: Computer-science undergraduate; strong grades; two scholarship years; no publication.
Deep learning and NLP; adjacent trustworthy AI acceptable; robotics-heavy programs excluded.
Industry research after PhD; East Asia options preferred but not exclusive.
Full tuition coverage and living stipend required.
No new always-on service; default deployment self-contained.
Single regional process; short TTL-bounded stale window acceptable.
Basic counters and short rollback runbook.
Profitable growth in high-potential segments; margin is a hard guardrail.
Capped margin investment only with measurable retention or repeat-purchase upside.
Two quarters; weekly readouts; predeclared scale/stop.
Marketing and regional operations; show opportunities, owners, test cells, decision dates.
